_doc: Missions (src/sim/game/missions.ts, docs/mechanics/missions.md; the script is docs/story.md): the story's chapters (kind story) and the side stories (kind side). Each: id, name, area (the journal's neighbourhood), giver (data/cast.json: where its marker stands), blurb, world (default sf; worlds: others with the same ground), after (missions done or skipped before its marker shows; the client's save), reward (sticker: a Sticker Book id; unlock: a secret skater), fail (lines said when it fails that way: time, lost, bail, mode), steps. Step kinds: talk (who, lines; offer: the first step, ending in Accept or Not now; phone: starts at once wherever you are; radius: how close to who), go (to a place, within radius), trick (an air of air seconds, a grind of grind metres on a line of feature, or a banked combo of points holding one of gaps or tricks; in its area: near a place within radius and/or inside box; count times, each: barks between), collect (items, within radius, item: what they are), deliver (from a place, if given, to a place within radius; noBail: a bail spills it), follow (who rides path at speed; stay within distance; more than lose seconds behind fails), mode (a game the game has: courier, bomb, muni, escape, skate, graffiti, combo, with route, won by win: deliveries, place, maxSeconds, pieces, best; muni, escape and skate are won by winning). Every step: text (the objective), say (barks as it starts), done (barks when done), seconds (a clock), actors (cast id -> x y z heading: where they stand from this step on). A place is a spot id, cast:<id> (where that character stands now) or x y z. A line: id (its voice line, assets/sound/voice/<id>.mp3, tools/gen_voices.py), who, text, say (a spelling for the voice). talkRadius, goRadius, collectRadius, deliverRadius: metres when a step gives none; height: metres up or down that still count as there; intro: the mission that starts by itself the first time.

missions.name: New in Town
missions.blurb: Karl the Fog appoints himself your mentor. Rosa decides if you can stay.

lines.text: Oh good, you're up. I'm Karl. Karl the Fog. You've seen my work.
Every summer I keep this whole city at fifty-eight degrees. You're welcome.
You just moved here with a board and a duffel bag. Bold. I'll be your mentor, since nobody asked.

New kid. Show me a kickflip.
Mid.
Like a six-dollar coffee. You'll drink it. You won't post it.

We're going to activate this space. Picture it: a micro-mobility experience hub.
It's a skatepark.
Exactly. For now. Let's circle back on your little hobby.

Land three real combos and you can stay. Before the vest comes back.

time.text: The window is closed. Come back tomorrow. The window is always closed.

missions.name: Dolores's Delay

mode.text: Huh. We weren't delayed. First time in fifteen years. I'm shaking.

We are always being held. Fifteen years, and I have never left a stop on time. It's peaceful.
Now they've parked the F for good. So for once, I'm exactly where the timetable says I am.
So they gave me the J Church. Meet me at Liberty and race my streetcar down through Dolores Park. You'll win. I'll be delayed. I can feel it.

missions.name: Sal's Turntable
missions.blurb: Sal has turned the cable car by hand for forty years. Show the tourists some respect.

lines.text: Forty years I've turned this cable car by hand. Forty years of tourists asking if it's a ride.

missions.name: Captain Barnacle Wants to Skate
missions.blurb: The elder of the K-dock wants the tourists to watch him shred, not nap.

lines.text: Ork. Ork. I am Captain Barnacle, elder of the K-dock. We have had seniority here since 1990.
lines.say: Ork. Ork. I am Captain Barnacle, elder of the K dock. We have had seniority here since nineteen ninety.

lines.text: Every day the tourists watch us nap. I want them to watch me shred.
Teach me, land-dweller. Start with a grind on one of these benches.

done.text: Magnificent. Like a herring sliding off a warm rock.

say.text: Now a big air. The kind that frightens gulls.

done.text: The gulls are frightened. Good. They know what they did.

say.text: Now link it all together, like sea lions in a pile.

lines.text: I have seen enough. Lend me your board, child. I will take it from here.
Tell the tourists the Captain skates now. Admission is still free.

missions.blurb: Gus has been a silver statue since 1987. Tourists stopped tipping. He needs a distraction.

lines.text: Don't talk to me. I'm a statue. I've been a statue since 1987.
lines.say: Don't talk to me. I'm a statue. I've been a statue since nineteen eighty-seven.

lines.text: Tourists stopped tipping. Do something loud near me, so I can keep not moving next to it.
A big combo. I stay perfectly still. That's the contrast. That's the art.

say.text: Go. I'm already not moving.

lines.text: Forty dollars in the bucket. I didn't blink. You almost made me blink.
Come back tomorrow. Same time. I'll be here. I'm always here. I can't feel my legs.

missions.name: Fry Thief
missions.blurb: Steve is a seagull. He steals fries. He dropped two, and wants them back.

lines.text: Kid. I'm a seagull. I steal fries. It's a calling.
I dropped two escaping a toddler. Fetch 'em and I won't follow you home.
lines.say: I dropped two escaping a toddler. Fetch them, and I won't follow you home.

done.text: Fresh fries. You're alright. From now on I only steal from people in hats.

missions.name: Free Verse
missions.blurb: Rocco writes poems about the fog. The fog never writes back. He needs a line with no rhythm and all feeling.

lines.text: I am Rocco. I write poems about the fog. The fog never writes back.
I read them. They are mid.
Skate me a line with no rhythm and all feeling. A long combo, here in the square.
Yes. A line that rhymes with nothing. That's North Beach.
I will call it Ode to a Kid Falling Up. Don't read it. Nobody reads it.

missions.name: Espresso, Not Expresso
missions.blurb: Every day for forty years Nonna Gia has brought Vito his espresso. Today her knees said no.

bail.text: You spilled it. On a Tuesday. Vito will talk about this for years.

lines.text: Every day for forty years I bring Vito his espresso. Today my knees said no.
Take it to the square. Don't spill. And it's espresso. If you say expresso, I'll know.

steps.text: The espresso to Vito, no spills

done.text: Espresso! Nonna is never late. Forty years. Must be love.

missions.name: Bocce Ball
missions.blurb: Enzo threw the bocce ball like a teenager. It rolled down Columbus.

lines.text: We play bocce since 1961. Today Enzo threw like a teenager, and the ball went down Columbus.
lines.say: We play bocce since nineteen sixty-one. Today Enzo threw like a teenager, and the ball went down Columbus.

lines.text: Bring it back. Enzo is too proud and I am too comfortable.

steps.text: Find the bocce ball down Columbus

done.text: Grazie. Enzo says it does not count. Enzo says that about everything.

missions.name: The Brake Shoe
missions.blurb: The Hyde St cable car's brake shoe rolled downhill. Mo would like it back before the next run.

lines.text: Hyde Street cable car. I work the brake. The brake shoe fell off and rolled downhill.
Find it before we try the hill without it. The tourists would love it. The insurance would not.

steps.text: Find the brake shoe down Hyde

done.text: Brake shoe! You saved forty tourists and one very nervous pigeon.

missions.name: Hydrangea Patrol
missions.blurb: Tourists keep picking Mrs. Fitch's hydrangeas on Lombard for photos.

lines.text: Tourists pick my hydrangeas for photos. Two hundred photos a day, one hydrangea left.
Grind the curb by my beds. Loudly. Make them think twice.

steps.text: Grind a curb by the flower beds

done.text: They fled. One even put a hydrangea back. Progress.

missions.name: Lion's Luck
missions.blurb: Kenny's lion dance needs luck before tonight. The old way is drums.

lines.text: Our lion dance needs luck before tonight. The old way is drums. The new way is you.
Ollie through the Dragon Gate. Big. The lion is watching. The lion is two guys.

steps.text: Big air by the Dragon Gate

done.text: Lucky! The lion nodded. That was Eddie in the back. He is a fan.

missions.name: Har Gow Express
missions.blurb: The lion dancers ordered har gow and are too busy being a lion to fetch it.

time.text: Cold har gow. I'm telling your mother.

lines.text: The lion dancers ordered har gow. They are too busy being a lion to come get it.
Down Grant to the gate, still steaming. Steam is how you know it is love.

steps.text: Har gow to the lion dancers, still steaming

done.text: Still steaming. Auntie Mei says hi, and also that we are too skinny.

missions.name: Named After You
missions.blurb: Benny names every sandwich after a regular. He's out of regulars.

lines.text: Every sandwich here is named after a regular. I'm out of regulars. Three of them are named after my landlord.
Do something worth a sandwich. Right here, where I can see it.

steps.text: A 500 combo in front of the shop

done.text: Done! The New Kid. Turkey, avocado, a little gravel. Eighteen dollars.

missions.name: The Wiggle
missions.blurb: Juniper got a flat on the Wiggle. Her zine has to reach Duboce Park.

time.text: You're late. That's fine. The zine is also about letting go.

lines.text: I ride the Wiggle every day. Today the Wiggle won. Flat tire.
Take this envelope to Duboce Park in one minute. It's a zine about not having brakes.

say.text: Go. Pretend you're a bike. Bikes are faster. Sorry.

done.text: Delivered? Rad. You'd make a decent messenger. Lose the brakes.

missions.name: Fortune, Written Daily
missions.blurb: Mr. Lau has written cookie fortunes for fifty years. Today he has writer's block.

lines.text: I write the fortunes for the cookie bakery. Fifty years. Today, nothing. Writer's block.
Do something I can write down. Something true. A kickflip, here, where I can see it.

done.text: 'You will see a kickflip on Grant Avenue.' Ten thousand cookies, and finally, all of them true.

missions.name: New Word
missions.blurb: Pistachio the parrot knows one word, and a skater taught it. Teach it a better one.

lines.text: Squawk! Pretty bird knows one word! A skater taught me! Mid! Mid!
Pretty bird wants a new word! Show pretty bird flying! Squawk!

steps.text: Fly for Pistachio (half a second of air)

done.text: Fly! Fly! Pretty bird says fly! Squawk!
Mid.

missions.name: Shore Leave
missions.blurb: Herb has four hours off the cruise ship and wants one real skateboard trick for the Christmas letter.

lines.text: Four hours off the boat and we've seen fog, a sea lion and a man dressed as a bush.
Linda wants a real skateboard trick for the Christmas letter. Something big. Linda, get the camera!

steps.text: Something big for Linda's camera (an 800 combo)

done.text: Linda! Did you get it? ... She got the bush man again.

missions.name: Follow the Flag
missions.blurb: Bernadette's Coit Tower tour rented scooters and left without her. They follow the flag, not her.

time.text: They're in Sausalito. They'll be back. They always come back. For the gift shop.

lines.text: Welcome to Coit Tower. My tour group rented scooters and left without me.
They follow the flag, not me. Take it to Pier 23 and they'll stop. Probably.

done.text: They stopped! They're following you now. Congratulations, you're a tour guide. The pay is terrible.

missions.name: Balance Solidarity
missions.blurb: Jasper fell off his slackline again. He needs to see someone else balance.

lines.text: I fell off the slackline. Again. The palm tree says hi.
Do a manual for me. It's a slackline, but on wheels, and worse.

done.text: Beautiful. You wobbled exactly like me. We are the same now.

missions.name: Oat Milk Emergency
missions.blurb: Gideon's twins are finally asleep. He left the oat milk on the café table across 24th.

time.text: Someone took it. It's Noe Valley. It was probably a golden retriever.

lines.text: The twins are asleep. If I move, they wake up. If they wake up, I move to Oakland.
My oat milk is on the café table across the street. Thirty seconds. Whisper-fast.

done.text: You're a hero. A quiet hero. Shh. Hero quieter.

missions.name: Above the Fog
missions.blurb: Misty, Karl's cousin, sits on Twin Peaks. She wants to see someone get above her.

lines.text: I'm Misty. Karl's cousin. He gets the city. I get this hill and a parking lot.
Show me something higher than me. Nobody's higher than me. That's the problem.

steps.text: Get some air on Twin Peaks

done.text: Huh. You were above the fog for a second there. Don't tell Karl.

missions.name: Four Minutes
missions.blurb: Walter has waited for the J Church since 2009. He could use some entertainment.

lines.text: The sign says the J is four minutes away. The sign has said that since 2009.
Do a little something while we wait. Anything. Something with points.

steps.text: A 400 combo by the J Church stop

done.text: Very nice. The J still isn't here. See you in 2031.

missions.name: Mayor Biscuits
missions.blurb: Lorraine's pug, Mayor Biscuits, ran off down Market and dropped things on the way.

time.text: Too slow. He found the hot dog. Now he is asleep on it. Classic Mayor.
time.say: Too slow. He found the hot dog. Now he's asleep on it. Classic Mayor.

lines.text: Mayor Biscuits got away from me again. He dropped my keys, my shoe and a hot dog that is not ours.
Find all three before he circles back for the hot dog.

done.text: Keys, shoe... no hot dog. He ate the hot dog. He always eats the hot dog.

missions.name: Local Honey
missions.blurb: Gloria ordered a jar of honey from Ruth at the UN Plaza market. It has to reach City Hall in one piece.

time.text: Gloria's office is closed. She says the honey can reapply tomorrow.

bail.text: Oh dear. The bees felt that. All of them.

lines.text: Gloria at City Hall ordered a jar of honey. She ordered it in triplicate.
Take it to her. Don't drop it. If the jar breaks, the bees will know.

steps.text: The honey to Gloria at City Hall, no bails

done.text: Honey. Acceptable. Tell Ruth that is my highest rating.

missions.name: Sugar Run
missions.blurb: Doña Chela is out of sugar. Don Beto's bakery on 24th has sugar, and opinions.

time.text: Too late. I sold them plain. Everyone said 'interesting'.

lines.text: Mija, I'm out of sugar. A churro without sugar is just a stick.
Don Beto has sugar. He also has opinions. Get the sugar, skip the opinions.

done.text: Sugar! Here, a churro. Don't tell Beto I said he has opinions.

missions.name: Something Very San Francisco
missions.blurb: The wedding shoot on the City Hall steps needs something very San Francisco in the background.

lines.text: My daughter wants something very San Francisco in the background of her wedding photos.
You are very San Francisco. Do a trick behind them. Tasteful. Then leave.

steps.text: Some air behind the wedding photo

done.text: Perfect. The bride is crying. The groom is also crying. Unclear why.

missions.name: Speed Chess
missions.blurb: Lev plays speed chess on Market Street. He moves, you land a trick.

time.text: Checkmate. Coffee. Black, four sugars.

lines.text: Speed chess. I move, you land a trick. Three of my moves, three of your tricks.
If I checkmate first, you buy the coffee. I always checkmate first.

steps.text: Three tricks before Lev checkmates (300 points each)

each.text: Pawn takes pawn. Kid takes curb.

done.text: You won. I don't say that. I said it once, in 1988. Now twice.

missions.name: Statue-Off
missions.blurb: There's a new silver statue at Pier 39. Gus wants to know if he's the real thing.

lines.text: There's a new statue at Pier 39. Silver paint. My silver. A copycat.
Go do something big next to him. If he moves, he's not a statue. He's just a guy.

steps.text: A 1,000 combo by the Pier 39 statue

done.text: He moved? He moved! Thirty-seven years and I never moved. Copycat.

missions.name: Kevin's Garbage Run
missions.blurb: Kevin sprained his ankle bombing Dolores. Somebody has to drive his route.

time.text: The raccoons got there first. They always get there first.

lines.text: Kevin. Three Bin Hauling. I bomb Dolores on my lunch break. Today Dolores bombed me.
Sprained ankle. Can you drive my route? Five bins round the park. The truck is very forgiving. The bins are not.

steps.text: Kevin's route: five bins round the park, in the truck

say.text: Pull up next to the bins. Beeping is optional but encouraged.

each.text: One down. The raccoons will be furious.
Ooh. That one smelled like a startup.
Halfway. You stop better than I do. Nine years, I still miss the green one.
One more. The raccoons are filing a complaint.

lines.text: Five for five. Everything is trash if you love it enough.
Leave the truck anywhere. Seriously. It's a garbage truck. Nobody steals a garbage truck.

missions.name: The Lost Tourist
missions.blurb: Bjorn from Stockholm is looking for the Golden Gate Bridge with a map from 1987. Drive him to Pier 39 and let him narrate.

lines.text: Hello! Bjorn, from Stockholm. I am looking for the Golden Gate Bridge. My map says it is here.
My map is from 1987. Can you drive me? I will narrate. I am very good at narrating.

say.text: Here! Over here! I am the one with the map!

lines.text: Ah! That building, I know it. The Golden Gate Bridge. Shorter than in the films.
And this must be the famous crooked street. It is so straight.
Alcatraz is very close to downtown, yes? My map says it is everywhere.
In 1987 my map says this was all water. Progress!

done.text: We are here! The Golden Gate Bridge. Why is it barking?

lines.text: Thank you! I will tell everyone in Stockholm that San Francisco is exactly as I imagined. Wrong, but exactly.

missions.name: Board Drop
missions.blurb: A shipment of decks came in at Fog City Skate Shop for the kids at SoMa West. Big Lou's knee is not driving.

time.text: The kids skated the old boards. Fine. The old boards are mostly tape anyway.

lines.text: Shipment came in. Twelve decks for the kids at SoMa West. My knee says I'm not driving.
Take the crew van. Corners slow. In 1996 I took a corner fast. That's the other knee.

steps.text: Twelve decks to the park gate, in the van

say.text: Easy on the brakes. They're decks, not eggs. Still.

done.text: New decks! I'll lose this one by Friday. Maybe Thursday.

missions.name: Catering, Gently
missions.blurb: City Hall ordered forty burritos for the permit office. Hector says the van must not hit anything.

time.text: The permit office ate lunch somewhere else. They have never done that. I am hurt.

bump.text: You hit something. I heard it from here. The salsa heard it too.

lines.text: City Hall ordered forty burritos for the permit office. Forty. Gloria signed for them in advance.
Take the van. Do not hit anything. A burrito that has been in a crash is a bowl.

steps.text: Forty burritos to City Hall, without a bump

say.text: Gently! Gently is the whole recipe.

done.text: Forty burritos. Thirty-nine intact. I am noting the one.

missions.name: Kenji's Board
missions.blurb: Kenji lost his board again. A seagull left it on a low roof by Duboce Park.

time.text: Too slow. The seagull came back for it. We're not friends anymore.

lines.text: Dude. I lost my board. Again. Fourth time this week.
It's on a roof by Duboce Park. A seagull took it. I don't want to talk about it.

steps.text: Kenji's board, on a low roof by Duboce Park

say.text: Pallets to the dumpster to the roof. Or the stairs, if you're boring.

steps.text: The board to Kenji, down in the park

say.text: Got it? I'm down in the park. Forty-five seconds, before I cry.

lines.text: My board! Was it always this ugly? I love it.
Next time it's up there, just leave it. It's happier up there.
